These are my working notes as I learn the mathematics behind quantum field
theory: abstract algebra first, then Lie groups and their representations, then
the physics that those structures organise. They are written for the version of
me who will read them six months from now, which means they favour *why* over
*what*, record the examples that made things click, and do not skip the
calculations.

Everything here is a work in progress. If you spot an error, I would be glad to
hear about it.

The notes are organised in three sections — [Algebra](algebra/index.qmd),
[Lie Theory](lie-theory/index.qmd), and [Quantum Field Theory](qft/index.qmd) —
and there is a longer, linear [book](book/index.html) that collects the polished
material into one text.
